name: Docker Compose App Type
description: Adds compose and compose:down app types to workspaces.
long_description: Demonstrates app_types: a plugin can claim its own workspace app types and decide what each one launches. Add `- type: compose` to a workspace and this plugin turns it into a `docker compose up -d` invocation, honoring the app's `file` convention via args and its cwd. Requires the apps:resolve capability, which is mutating because the command this plugin returns is executed by dia.
author: dia
